_comment: Per-character physical identity: ethnicity, build, features. Jeremy, 2026-10-01.
USE: injected into every GENERATION prompt (local shot plan, asset renders, eval
scenes) and available to the game persona/chat. NEVER written into a training
caption - these are identity traits; captioning one keeps it variable and the
LoRA never learns it. Make them VISIBLE in the images instead (fitted outfits
on 3/4 and waist-up frames). Folds into CharacterSource when a source.json exists.
`prompt` is the ready-made clause; keep it concrete (skin, hair, eyes, build) -
a heritage label alone steers Qwen weakly.
